title: The Hollow Wolf Revisited
author: Juniper Halloran
blurb: Felix Halloran, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
